title: About Oxford
details:
A Special Set-Up

The Oxford English Centre was established in 2011 as a private English Language Teaching (ELT) Centre and one of the very few centers, if not the only in Gaza, targeting adult Language Learners. It is a proud local ELT Service -Provider accredited by The Palestinian Ministry of Education and adopts the most modern ELT methodologies including The Communicative Learner-Centered and The Task-Based Approaches allowing for more learner autonomy. The Centre is led by an experienced and socially- responsible team of young highly-qualified Palestinian administrators and academics.

A Convenient Location and Welcoming Atmosphere

Oxford is located in a convenient location in Ansar Square within a walking distance from Gaza universities and covers an area of 350 m2 on the third floor of Mushtaha Tower(6). The facility has six highly equipped and air-conditioned training rooms with a maximum capacity of 15 participants per room, along with a reception and a spacious veranda devoted for clients' tea breaks overlooking Al- Katibah Park, not to mention the Ladies' and Gents' toilets and the small kitchen where clients are welcome to serve themselves hot drinks. In addition, Oxford has a separate quite administration room, yet Top Management is approachable allowing clients to feel supported in a friendly way. In a second separate flat located on the same floor, two highly-equipped spacious halls are devoted for Conferences and Training constituting together a maximum capacity of 70 trainees and participants . The entire place features Georgian and late Victorian interior design, the thing which Oxford exclusively offers as an added value to its clients in order to the best academic atmosphere integrated with a cultural experience Gazans cannot have elsewhere in their besieged Strip.

Our Mission

Our mission is to inspire our students to achieve their potential and their personal goals in language learning in a supportive environment.

Our Ethos

A high quality of student welfare is central to our ethos, along with a high standard of teaching and learning.

Our aims include:

  1. being a centre where the well-being of everyone is the prime concern of each member of our community.

title: Oxford Promise
details:
The Oxford promise and what it means to you

Our unique Oxford Promise means that, as long as you follow your personalised learning programme and take the three steps outlined below, we promise that your English will improve.

Attendance

Class attendance is an individual student responsibility. Attend 96% of your English language classes.

Homework

Compete at least three homework assignments weekly with an average score of 9/10.

Participation

Actively participate in lessons with an average score of 9/10 for participation and motivation.

Progress Planner

Our Progress Planner below will help you plan your route to fluency, and be confident that your success is guaranteed. Get an idea of how many lessons you need to get to your target level by simply counting the weeks.

Help and support

There’s even more to our promise to you: if you do everything required but you do not progress as expected, we will give you the additional lessons, help and support you need at no extra cost, to maximise your progress.*

We promise you

A friendly learning environment.
A high standard of teaching and student welfare.
Appropriate facilities for language learning.
Practical ideas and guidance for personal study outside lesson times.
A varied social programme to complement your learning.
A quick response to any questions or problems.

 

*Students who do not progress and wish to receive the Oxford Promise of extra lessons and support must contact their Director of Studies at least one week prior to departure. Other terms and conditions apply. Speak with your Oxford contact for more details.

title: Our Teaching Methods
details:
From the first day you will be encouraged to use English in the classroom to communicate with the teacher and other students. The more you speak, the easier it becomes to learn the language. Our aim is to teach you in the most effective way possible, and in a fun and enjoyable environment.

We believe that language learning is most successful when:

  • it takes place in a stress-free environment
  • students actively participate in lessons and are challenged and stimulated
  • a variety of media and other activities are used to cater for all learning styles
  • teachers are positive and supportive and have access to a wide range of teaching aids
  • students' progress is continually assessed in all areas of spoken and written English, based on work done in the classroom and at home.

 

We love what we do

Teaching English isn’t just a job for us, it’s a passion. We take pride in our students' achievements.

We go the extra mile

As far as we’re concerned there’s no such thing as ‘good enough’. We do a great job and then go further, doing whatever it takes to achieve success on your behalf.

We deliver what we promise

The results we offer aren’t simply an aspiration or target, they’re guaranteed. When you study with us you know that we’ll make sure you meet your goals.

We have a can-do mindset

We see opportunities, not problems. We concentrate on how much you can achieve, instead of the things you can't do.

title: IELTS Preparation Course
details:
Improve Your Academic and Professional Life and Start with IELTS for a Better Future

IELTS – the International English Language Testing System – is the world’s most popular English language test. It is developed by some of the world’s leading experts in language assessment and evaluates all of your English skills reading, writing, listening and speaking. The test reflects how you’ll use English to study, work and live in an English speaking environment.

We believe that just doing practice IELTS exams and exercises is not the best way to raise your IELTS level. To be successful in this exam you need a wide range of vocabulary and syntax. Our course is designed to build these areas using engaging, authentic situations while providing plenty of exam skills and practice. Through weekly reviews and coaching,

monthly tests, regular filming and mock IELTS tests we measure your progress clearly and visibly to highlight strengths, needs and objectives.

Our course helps you to:

• be confident in handling all aspects of the exam

• express your thoughts and opinions fluently

• use grammar and vocabulary effectively

• overcome anxiety with intensive exam practice

title: General English Levels (CEFRL)
details:
Our General English courses It covers reading, writing, speaking, listening, grammar, vocabulary and critical thinking. In this class you'll improve your accuracy (how correct your English is) and fluency (how well you can communicate). Lessons have daily and weekly objectives so you know what you’ll learn and how you’ll learn it. Our teachers provide you with regular assessments that allow you to keep track of your progress.

 We use the Communicative Approach, so you'll learn English by using English not by listening to grammar lectures and doing worksheets. We feel strongly that this is the most effective method to acquire English that students can use in the real world.

The Syllabus for each level is mapped to the CEFR levels A1-C1. The levels define what you can do and Oxford English Centre believes that language is for communication. Each of our Core Class Course Books is also mapped to the CEFR providing a consistent basis for developing your language skills.

title: Speaking Course
details:
Our Focus on Speaking course combines self-study vocabulary exercises and a focus on natural English pronunciation with intensive speaking practice.

Using material from a specially designed workbook, you will do a variety of communicative tasks and your teacher will give you advice about how you can improve the fluency and accuracy of your spoken English.

 

TAKE A FOCUS ON SPEAKING COURSE AND YOU WILL:

  • Get a qualified and experienced teacher
  • Work in pairs and groups to discuss six different topics
  • Improve your pronunciation
  • Enjoy speaking English.

 

The course is designed to increase your active vocabulary and give you more confidence and control when speaking in English. Many students will take a General English and a Focus on Speaking course

title: Academic WritIng Course
details:
Improve your written English abilities for work, study and life

This is the ideal course if you need to improve your writing skills to achieve success at university either at under-graduate or post-graduate level. This course will help you develop your planning, drafting and editing skills which are essential when writing a dissertation or thesis. You will also practise techniques and language to give your written style a more formal and academic tone.

You will complete five writing tasks and receive personalised feedback and counselling from your teacher.

 ON THIS COURSE YOU WILL:

  •  Learn to structure and organise a range of written texts
  •  Practice planning and editing your own writing
  •  Learn phrases and vocabulary typical in academic writing
  •  Create a portfolio to showcase your written work

WHY SHOULD YOU CHOOSE THIS COURSE FROM THE OXFORD ENGLISH CENTRE?

Be taught by highly qualified teacher

  • Enjoy lessons that use modern teaching methods and materials.
  • Gain access to the LearnEnglish website featuring thousands of hints, tips, games and downloads
  • See your ability to plan and write a range of academic texts improve

HOW IS THIS COURSE STRUCTURED?

This course is for students placed at intermediate and above. Your teacher will introduce different types of written texts typically needed at university or in higher education. You will write a number of essays and analyse typical features in other genres such as personal statements and reports.

You will need to take a placement test to determine that your writing skills are at the appropriate level.

title: Business English Course
details:
Improve your confidence and impact in today’s global business world

Our business English courses focus on the situations that are most relevant to your employees' everyday working lives.

The teacher will select materials to help with the specific areas they need to improve. These include negotiating skills, emailing, giving presentations, managing meetings and more.

Learn the world’s business language with Oxford your employees will:

  1. improve every aspect of their English to communicate better in the workplace 
  2. use targeted, up-to-date business materials that help with the specific areas they need to improve
  3. meet other professionals, share business ideas and solutions and build their professional network
  4. experience business focused lessons, allowing them to practice English through role-plays, presentations and written tasks
  5. learn in a professional, business-like environment with all the latest technology

FAQs

Do I need to take an entry test before I book?

No, you’ll be tested on arrival to make sure you’re in a class that’s just right for your level.

title: English for Specific Purposes - ESP
details:
English for Specific Purposes, or ESP, refers to learning English because you have a specific need. It can include the area of EPP, English for Professional Purposes.

Our ESP courses are designed to help you improve your English in a specific professional context. Where a business English programme tends to provide a general approach to formal English, ESP courses are workplace-specific and focus on how English is used in fields such as IT, medicine and finance .

Example

Survival English for immigrants, English for Hotel Management, and English for Air Traffic Controllers are all ESP.

In the classroom

Asking learners what they need to learn is an important element of ESP classes, as often their language needs and aims are very specific. This data can then be combined with the teacher's analysis of core language and learning needs in order to prepare a syllabus.

title: Oxford IELTS Prize
details:
Oxford English Centre is offering 5 IELTS fee Prize every year to students of Oxford who score 8.0 and above in their IELTS test.

 

Why we are offering Oxford IELTS Prize

We offer Oxford Prize as a humble contribution to the local community and as a gesture of encouragement to our students.

What is an OXFORD IELTS Prize?
It will cover the cost (currently 1000 NIS) of registering to take an IELTS test for 5 candidates every year. If you get a score of 8.0 or above in the test.

How to apply
If you wish to apply for Oxford Prize, you should complete the application form and send us a copy of your IELTS certificate at: info@oxford.ps.

title: Oxford Community
details:
Oxford English Centre: A private-sector practical and concert model to advance sustainable development

Oxford English Centre-Gaza has committed itself towards sustainable development through offering quality education and life-changing learning experiences to Gaza youth. As a private sector institution working under the umbrella of the following SDGs: Goals 4, 5 and 8, we aim to further advance sustainable development in Gaza through launching our SDGs-oriented community.

Oxford Community

Oxford Community is a non-profit initiative by The Oxford English Centre to contribute to sustainable development in Gaza. It was launched in September 2018 targeting Palestinian youth through capacity building programmes, community service programmes and raising the awareness about SDGs.

Our Mission

To effectively contribute to sustainable development in Gaza through engaging and empowering youth

Our Objectives

  1. Raising awareness among our students’ network to make a significant impact on the SDGs
  2. Helping students understand and engage with the 2030 SDGs
  3. Offering capacity building programmes and dynamic learning environments
  4. Creating a platform for SDGs-oriented community service groups made of volunteers
  5. Working with local NGOs, governmental and private sector organisations to launch SDGs-informed initiatives

title: Welcome To Oxford
details:
The Oxford English Centre has been delivering high quality English language tuition to students since its establishment in 2011 and has built a strong reputation as one of the most prestigious English language Centres in Gaza.

We make it our mission to welcome you into our family of staff, teachers and students. From the moment you first walk through our door we will do everything possible to make you feel at home, and ensure your course and your stay with us are smooth, fun, and productive.

title: Privacy Policy
details:
Your privacy is important to us. It is oxford's policy to respect your privacy regarding any information we may collect from you across our website, http://oxford.ps, and other sites we own and operate.

We only ask for personal information when we truly need it to provide a service to you. We collect it by fair and lawful means, with your knowledge and consent. We also let you know why we’re collecting it and how it will be used.

We only retain collected information for as long as necessary to provide you with your requested service. What data we store, we’ll protect within commercially acceptable means to prevent loss and theft, as well as unauthorised access, disclosure, copying, use or modification.

We don’t share any personally identifying information publicly or with third-parties, except when required to by law.

Our website may link to external sites that are not operated by us. Please be aware that we have no control over the content and practices of these sites, and cannot accept responsibility or liability for their respective privacy policies.

You are free to refuse our request for your personal information, with the understanding that we may be unable to provide you with some of your desired services.

Your continued use of our website will be regarded as acceptance of our practices around privacy and personal information. If you have any questions about how we handle user data and personal information, feel free to contact us.

This policy is effective as of 23 July 2019.

title: Terms of Service
details: Oxford was established by distinguished TESOL experts who are well-informed with broad knowledge in material design and selection with relevant academic and professional experience spanned over 10 years as researchers and Language Instructors. Oxford has a solid reputation in appointing distinguished A-List staff members who are all committed to the concept of creating a difference in the Palestinian educational life through transferring the cognition and expertise they gained from their studies in both the UK and the US. They are all inspiring figures, scholarships winners and leaders in their fields. Thus, we believe we can add value to the training by giving trainees models to follow and providing them with a great inspirational atmosphere.

title: Flexible Timetable
details: We also offer timetables that give you the flexibility to choose a course that best suits your needs.

title: Quality Teachers
details: All of our staff are qualified teachers and are native-like speakers. We have many years of experience between us! We believe in supporting our students to apply their learning to everyday life, helping you to not only achieve your goals but to exceed your expectations.

title: Excellent Value

We give you a free consultation before you start your classes to develop your specific learning programme. title: Happy Students
details: We are proud of our reputation for treating our students in a friendly, respectful and professional manner at all times. Based on feedback from 232 students, 92% were happy with their classes; 97% were happy with their teachers; 94% were happy with the centre.
